question: What does the text toolbar Link open, where, and what HTML does a link write?
base:
On desktop the smallest a row can be is the container width times 0.0215. A 1400px container gives rows of 30.1px. On phones rows start at a fixed 24px.

Row height follows the width, so a layout keeps its proportions when the window changes.
